The Fissure is the seedy underbelly of Dornogal, found in the eastern corner of the city. Various types of trade appear to take place here, from barbershop services to the illicit dealings of Steelvein. A few outsiders have also established themselves, including Madam Goya of the Black Market Auction House and Griftah. Several displaced rogues from Dalaran have gathered near the back of the Fissure with some of their remaining possessions. The Forgegrounds lie to the southwest, and there's an entrance to the Corridors leading north to the Stoneshaper's Atrium. After Uniting Severed Threads is completed, a tunnel to the Weaver's Lair becomes available at the back of the Fissure.

Flashfrost Assault is an area found in the Waking Shores, east of the Ruby Lifeshrine and west of Flashfrost Enclave. It contains the entrance to the Ruby Life Pools and was attacked by Primalist forces seeking to capture the area. The earth and ice elementals under their command have transformed the region into a frozen battlefield, and while the red dragonflight has maintained a barricade, some of the Primalist forces were able to breach their defenses.

Flayscale Camp is a Qalashi djaradin settlement found in the Waking Shores, east of the Obsidian Citadel and west of the Overflowing Rapids. The area contains large numbers of both dragon and proto-dragon corpses, as well as numerous dragon skulls. Dead dragons are present both on the ground and hung from chains, while the proto-drakes are found only in pieces, typically around cooking sites and workstations. At the southern edge of camp is the Flayscale Cavern. Several infused proto-dragons can be seen circling over the area. With War Mode enabled, the area is a Free For All and Overcoming A Mountain: Krolkoth is sometimes available.

with the Flintridges' possessions outside their former estate.]] The Flintridges were an aristocratic human family of Stormwind. Their father once hired Stalvan Mistmantle to tutor his children. The man became smitten with the daughter, Tilloa, and eventually murdered the whole family in a fit of jealousy. The family owned an estate in the Canal District of Stormwind City and a summer cottage near the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn. Folsom used to be the caretaker of the Flintridge estate, as was his father before him. After the Flintridges' deaths, the last funds of their trust eventually dried up and their possessions were headed for auction.

The G.R.I.D. is the topmost section of the Warcraft Rumble store tab, where players can spend Arclight Coins to buy Warcraft Minis and talents. The G.R.I.D. has 9 slots, arranged in 3 rows and 3 columns. Purchasing a mini or talent will shuffle all of the slots in the same row and column, removing any options that were in those slots and placing new ones. Sometimes an XP Boost will appear in a slot; these grant XP to any mini purchased in the same row or column. Purchasing an already-owned mini will grant Star Points based on the purchased mini's rarity. The G-99 Breakneck is a hot rod awarded to players in License Not Required, part of the second chapter of the Undermine(d) campaign. This is technically not a mount, but a customizable D.R.I.V.E. vehicle, and only works in Undermine. D.R.I.V.E., or Dynamic and Revolutionary Improvements to Vehicular Experiences, is an experiment and iteration of ground mounts in the same vein of the transition from Steady Flight to Skyriding.

Garek Bandarion was a Forsaken paladin and the first Captain of the Deathguard. In life, he was human warrior in service to the Lordaeron City Guard under Captain Landen, who chose him as his successor -- an opportunity that never came due to the downfall of the kingdom of Lordaeron. After he killed Baron Rivendare and died of his wounds, Garek was one of many who rose as an undead of the Scourge. After he regained his free will but lost his memory, Garek pledged his allegiance to Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken, and eventually rose as the first leader of the Deathguard and the first Forsaken paladin. Geomentals are a type of protoform elemental found in Zereth Mortis. They share the appearance of the earth elementals and use similar abilities. Creating them requires two components: the Glimmer of Metamorphosis to synthesize their soul and the Geomental Lattice to form their bodies. Lihuvim's geomental creations are the most majestic of walking rock piles. The geomentals within the Untamed Verdure have become deviants after the area was abandoned for too long.
